waybackify [flags] [command]

manifest / rewrite / ledger / check / search + the cache store group over the spv/waybackify library

Human-operable, xargs-composable front door over spv/waybackify:
generate a manifest for a source file, rewrite it to its published
form, survey the ledger of manifests under a tree, hand-check a
capture, re-pick a better one, and — under the `cache` group —
populate, verify, remaster, and project the wayback.charlie.dev
mirror image.

Exit codes: 0 success · 1 domain failure (bad verdict / not found) ·
2 usage error · 3 suspect verdict (check only).

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  manifest    Generate the manifest for one markdown source
  rewrite     Apply a manifest to a markdown source
  ledger      Survey the manifests under a tree
  check       Full wayback-404 verdict for the exact capture
  search      CDX capture query — re-pick a better capture
  cache       Cache-store ops: add · fill · verify · remaster · sync

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
